pick.headline: Solzhenitsyn returns to Russia via Vladivostok
pick.fbis: The Central Eurasia Daily Report of May 27, 1994, carried an ITAR-TASS press review listing Solzhenitsyn's forthcoming arrival in Vladivostok among the day's stories, with a bus seizure, Crimea and Yeltsin's counterintelligence meeting.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Central Eurasia, No. 103, 27 May 1994
evidence.snippet: …riday run reports by their own correspondents and news agencies about the seizure of a bus near Mineralnye Vody by terrorists, the situation concerning the Crimea, the forthcoming arrival of world-famed writer Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn in Vladivostok, and the Russian president’s meeting with the leaders of the Federal Counter- Intelligence Service (FCS).
